# Cncf Dosec Member Reviewer

Review Dosec (member) using its official documentation and repository in the CNCF Members / Silver category. Dosec is a cloud-native security solution provider with security protection capabilities for containers, kubernetes, microservices, serverless, and DevOps.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
